temperature_K.description: Prescribed cell operating temperature in kelvin; not a solved stack temperature.

hydrogen_partial_pressure_atm.description: Hydrogen species partial pressure in atm, strictly positive.

oxygen_partial_pressure_atm.description: Oxygen species partial pressure in atm, not total air pressure.

active_area_cm2.description: Single-cell electrochemically active area in cm², strictly positive.

membrane_thickness_cm.description: Membrane thickness in cm, strictly positive.

membrane_water_content.description: Prescribed dimensionless membrane parameter lambda, from 14 through 23; not ambient RH.

cell_count.description: Positive integer number of single cells connected in series.

current_start_A.description: Nonnegative current sweep start in A, with at least two supported samples.

current_stop_A.description: Exclusive current stop in A; OPEM caps it at active_area_cm2 times max_current_density_A_cm2.

current_step_A.description: Positive current increment in A, advancing under OPEM rounding; at most 10,000 samples.

max_current_density_A_cm2.description: Positive limiting current density JMax in A/cm², used by the source concentration-loss model.

electronic_resistance_ohm.description: Nonnegative electronic resistance in ohm; native OPEM default is zero.

output_dir.description: Output base directory; a new isolated invocation subdirectory is created, default ./results.
